interpretation: Useful primary base, pooled and uniform advantage remains unresolved under both interval methods; donor excludes useful advantage only under writer resampling. Primary base favors personal adaptation at zero only under writer resampling without establishing the useful margin. Residual donor advantage is excluded only under writer resampling; pooled remains unresolved under both and uniform excludes useful advantage under both. Raw sums retain pooled uncertainty under both methods and base uncertainty under crossed resampling; raw donor excludes useful advantage under both. Raw base and donor favor personal adaptation at zero only under writer resampling; raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods.
